product_results.title: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026 75456
product_results.description: This is the way… to count down to Christmas. The LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026 (75456) building toy for kids ages 6 years old and up sparks daily creative fun during the holiday season. Discover iconic characters as they’ve never been seen before: The Mandalorian and Moff Gideon LEGO minifigures, plus Grogu and Pit Droid LEGO figures all in holiday outfits. Mando and Grogu have complementary sweaters, where Grogu’s features an image of Mando and Mando’s has an image of Grogu. Find 8 mini build vehicles, including an X-wing in festive colors. Look out for mini build toys for kids including LEGO figures of a Blurrg, Mudhorn, Bantha and Dewback. Packed with collectible Star Wars: The Mandalorian themed mini building toys, this Christmas advent calendar for kids makes an exciting early Christmas gift for boys, girls and any fans ages 6 years old and up. With a surprise treat every day, this festive LEGO advent calendar offers hours of fun and family-bonding activities to enjoy throughout the run-up to Christmas. Contains 293 pieces.

item_specifications.special_feature: Since 1958, LEGO bricks have met the highest industry standards, so they are consistent, compatible and connect and come apart easily every time – and it's still that way today

about_item: STAR WARS ADVENT CALENDAR 2026 – Find surprise brick-built LEGO toys behind every door for kids to create their own festive Star Wars: The Mandalorian adventures with the LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026 (75456) building toy for kids ages 6 years old and up
ICONIC CHARACTERS – Discover The Mandalorian and Grogu in holiday sweaters, Moff Gideon, Carson Teva and Jawa LEGO minifigures, plus LEGO figures of IG-11 and a Pit Droid in festive colors

8 MINI BUILD VEHICLES – Discover Mando’s N-1 Starfighter, The Razor Crest, a speeder bike, Sandcrawler, Imperial Shuttle, Mandalorian Gauntlet Fighter, Imperial Light Cruiser and an X-wing in festive colors
MORE MINI BUILD TOYS FOR KIDS – LEGO figures of a Mudhorn, Bantha, Dewback and Blurrg, plus 3 tables with beskar, gifts and Moff Gideon’s accessories, a weapons rack and Grogu’s hoverpram
EARLY CHRISTMAS GIFT IDEA – This LEGO advent calendar for kids ages 6 years old and up makes an awesome holiday gift for boys, girls and any Star Wars: The Mandalorian fans
EXPANDED PLAY – The mini builds and characters in this set can be added to other LEGO Star Wars sets (each sold separately) for endless play possibilities
HOLIDAY ACTIVITY – This 293-piece Christmas advent calendar for kids is great for boys and girls to build and play with either solo or with family and friends as a holiday bonding activity
